Net: the frontier-first focused-task selector improves learning efficiency in the demonstrable senses (distinct decisive cells, no redundant re-tests, auditable selection) while a strict causal 'more information per activation' claim remains unresolved for lack of a controlled comparison.

This shows the written novelty guard (LEARNING_EFFICIENCY.md section 2; LEARNING_STATE.md Learning rule 2) is declarative, not operative: nothing forces a pre-launch equivalence check against existing research/checks files and artifacts. Net: resolved-cell protection is real and RETAINED; a MINIMAL operative novelty guard is SUFFICIENT to close the residual near-duplicate class (a pre-launch search of research/checks/ + state/check_artifacts/ + the durable record, recorded as one line naming the closest existing work and why the new work is not equivalent). No broad metadata system is warranted.
research_conclusion: Cost robustness is classified and independently verified: lookback 3/5/10 momentum under the repository's realistic cost model and a 2x stress is cost-robust for 6/10 assets (0 fragile, 0 eliminated), and the gross 0x column reproduces the admitted momentum_lookback_sweep exactly. HOWEVER the verification uncovered a framework defect: momentum_signals (and mean_reversion_signals) use the mean log PRICE rather than the mean log RETURN, so the signal is effectively constant-long (short=0, <=1 flip for 9/10 assets; only NVDA, with sub-$1 split-adjusted prices, toggles). The 'short-horizon momentum edge' is therefore a constant-dollar always-long large-cap drift bet; its cost robustness is a property of low turnover, not of a directional momentum strategy. The admitted momentum/reversal evidence should be treated as provisional pending a corrected-signal re-test.

Root cause of the degenerate signal (empirically confirmed): momentum_signals computes np.mean(np.log(closes[i-lookback+1:i+1])) = mean log PRICE, not a return; for prices > $1 the sign is always positive, so the weight is +1 on every non-neutral bar. mean_reversion_signals shares the same construction (mirrored).
